Subject: Priya Shah — multi-window runbook & waitlist options

Hi All,

We have Priya Shah (applied for Senior Infra Engineer) who can only do windows on the 4th and 6th this week: 09:00–11:30 PT and 16:00–18:00 PT respectively. Candidate has asked about waitlist/backup slots (she's interviewing elsewhere this week). Can Acme put her on a short waitlist for any earlier openings and confirm which of our panelists can be moved earlier if a slot opens?

Prefer a 4-slot virtual onsite (system design -> coding -> infra deep-dive -> manager), with 20-minute buffers between sessions. If we need to compress to 3 slots, Marissa, can you advise which two sessions are least risky to combine?

Karthik/Laura — share any hard blocker windows today so we can give Acme a concrete set to propose.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Priya can hold 4th (AM) and 6th (PM) as you noted. I've added her to a short waitlist for any earlier cancellations and asked other candidates to release tentative slots by EOD tomorrow.

Acme proposed windows (we'll confirm by 8/2):
- 8/4 09:30–13:00 PT (we can split into 4x40m with breaks)
- 8/6 16:00–18:30 PT (tight, would need 10m buffer between some sessions)

Per your ask, the following panelists have some flexibility if we need to move earlier: Laura B. (can squeeze earlier between 08:30–11:00 PT on 8/4), Karthik I. (flexible after 10:00 PT on 8/4), Marissa C. (limited but can cover 8/4 AM). I'll hold these as potential swaps and notify you immediately if an earlier slot opens.

Thanks Sara — and Laura/Karthik/Marissa, quick answers appreciated so I can authorize Acme to finalize.

Laura — can you confirm you can lead System Design (slot 1) and be available for an earlier swap if Acme spots a cancellation? If so, we'll mark you as the primary for lead signal and as the primary swap candidate.

Karthik — can you take Coding (slot 2) and indicate whether you prefer a 60m deep-coding or 40m + short follow-up?

Marissa — if we must compress to three slots, recommended pairings? My vote would be combine infra deep-dive + manager into one 60m (infra core questions with a shorter culture handoff) but open to your operational POV.

I'm including an updated panel roster (panel_roster_v2.pdf) with suggested fallback order (Laura -> Karthik -> Marissa -> Ben) and who covers which competency. If you agree, I'll tell Acme to hold the earlier windows with that sequencing.

Ben

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 8:12 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'm including an updated panel roster (panel_roster_v2.pdf) with suggested fallback order (Laura -> Karthik -> Marissa -> Ben) and who covers which competency. If you agree, I'll tell Acme to hold the earlier windows with that sequencing.

Agree on leading system design and happy to be first in the fallback order. If an earlier cancellation appears, I can move up but would need 48 hours notice for travel/meeting prep.

Karthik — 40m coding + 20m follow-up works best for me as an interviewer pairing; keep the deep problem to 40m, then a short buffer for clarifying questions.

Marissa — I'd compress infra + manager only if we keep 60m total and ensure a hiring manager (Ben) is available for the final 10 minutes to cover compensation/timeline. Otherwise I'd prefer a full 4-slot cadence.

Operational notes for Acme/Sara:
- Please confirm which candidate will be queued for waitlist ahead of Priya (so we know expected churn).
- If Acme finalizes an earlier slot, route calendar updates to all panelists and include a 20m pre-meeting sync (optional) with the hiring manager.

Laura Bennett
